waivers.reason: The full image is the single-container quickstart: it starts the bundled PostgreSQL as the postgres user and uses the host's Docker socket, so it starts as root. docker run --user 10001 runs it without root against an external database, and the Helm chart runs it as UID 10001.
No layer runs dist-upgrade. Dockle 0.4.15 reports any apt-get command that also names the apt package; these layers install apt and libapt-pkg as fixed-version floors.
settings.py of the MCP Python SDK is source code (the auth server's settings model), not a credential; Dockle matches the file name only. The release secret scan reads file contents.
The bottleneck npm package ships a 37-byte .env test configuration that sets only REDIS_HOST and REDIS_PORT; it holds no credential. The release secret scan reads file contents.
The apk add without --no-cache is the python base image's own layer (apk add --no-network for the runtime dependencies), which leaves /var/cache/apk empty.
The flagged layer is the Debian 13 base image's own, which clears /var/lib/apt/lists with apt-get dist-clean; Dockle 0.4.15 only recognises rm -rf.
